text_block_list.text:
December ◎ | Noon | Wind: Perfect 
Favorable Breeze "Raise the Sails! Full 
Speed Ahead!" ====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
They've gathered a crew truly worthy of 
this year-end naval battle, but I will 
definitely win. There's no way in hell 
I'll let my crew shed tears of regret!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
If you think you can beat us, just try. 
Try to sink it, this ship headed for the 
world! We're heading to battle!
